title: Lifecycle Growth Sprint — Experiment Backlog + Prioritization (ICE)
body:
Working doc (not polished). Goal is to keep a single list of candidate lifecycle experiments + prioritize what we ship in the 3-week sprint.

Sprint objective (primary): lift activation = “first successful production-like inference call” within 24h/72h of signup.
Secondary: improve D7/D14 retention + move users to higher-intent milestones (billing added, token usage ramp, route/deployment created, invite teammates).

Levers this sprint (parallel):
1) Onboarding email sequences
2) In-console nudges (checklist + banners + JIT prompts)
3) Retargeting for non-activated + recently lapsed

ICE scoring rubric (1–10 each):
- Impact: expected lift on primary metric (activation within 72h) and/or time-to-first-success
- Confidence: based on existing evidence (Support blockers, baseline funnel, past experiments)
- Ease: eng/design/ops complexity; includes risk to SLOs + privacy/compliance overhead
ICE Total = (Impact + Confidence + Ease) / 3. (We’re using average for quick sorting.)

Hard constraints / guardrails:
- Email deliverability + suppressions must be correct (esp. opt-out handling)
- Any console changes behind feature flag + rollback plan; must not degrade console performance
- Claims in email/ads must be substantiated (benchmarks links) — PMM review required
- Tracking must respect consent / retention policy (see marketing tracking data review)

Dependencies that gate multiple items:
- Event taxonomy final + emitted reliably (api_key_created, first_request_success, first_streaming_success, dashboard_viewed, billing_added, etc.) [ENG-2841]
- Experiment assignment + feature flags for console [ENG-2842]
- UTM capture + stitching into product analytics events [ENG-2844]

----------------------------------------------------------------------
PRIORITIZED BACKLOG (sorted approx. by ICE Total)
----------------------------------------------------------------------
Columns:
ID | Experiment | Lever | Hypothesis | Segment | Primary metric | Impact | Conf | Ease | ICE | Dependencies | Owner(s) | Status | In/Out

EXP-01 | 5-email onboarding sequence v1 (welcome → quickstart → first success → troubleshooting → next step) | Email | Timed, role-based guidance reduces setup errors and increases first_success within 72h | New self-serve signups | Activation @72h; time-to-first-success | 9 | 7 | 8 | 8.0 | PM-413; deliverability plan; event triggers | Ben + Tyler + Soojin | Draft copy in progress | IN (Sprint)

EXP-02 | Email trigger on api_key_created but no first_success in 2h (“you’re one step away”) | Email | Catch users who created key but stalled; nudge to run 1 copy/paste call | New signups | Activation @24h; time-to-first-success | 8 | 7 | 7 | 7.3 | Reliable api_key_created + first_success events | Tyler + Paula | Blocked on event QA | IN (Sprint)

EXP-03 | Console activation checklist (4–5 steps) on dashboard w/ progress + deep links | Console | Visible checklist reduces ambiguity and drives completion of key milestones | New signups; returning non-activated | Activation @72h; checklist completion rate | 9 | 6 | 7 | 7.3 | ENG-2842/2843; design spec; perf check | Marissa + Tessa + Jada | In build behind flag | IN (Sprint)

EXP-04 | Console banner: “Make your first request” with copy-paste curl + SDK tabs | Console | Reduce first-request friction; improve time-to-first-success | New signups (no first_success) | Time-to-first-success; activation @24h | 8 | 6 | 7 | 7.0 | Docs snippet alignment; instrumentation | Marissa + Kenji | Scoped for v1 | IN (Sprint)

EXP-05 | Retargeting audience: signed up but no first_success within 7 days | Retargeting | Reminder + proof points bring developers back to finish setup | Non-activated signups | Activation within 7d of ad click; assisted activation | 7 | 6 | 7 | 6.7 | UTM + audience definitions; landing variant | Ben + Tyler | Audience rules drafted | IN (Sprint)

EXP-06 | Retargeting audience: lapsed users (had first_success, then 0 usage in 14d) w/ “ship it” messaging | Retargeting | Re-engage users by showing next-step value (streaming, dashboards, cost) | Recently lapsed | D14 retention; reactivation | 7 | 5 | 7 | 6.3 | UTM; lifecycle definition; suppression rules | Ben + Tyler | Needs final definition | IN (Sprint) if time

EXP-07 | “First streaming success” nudge (console + email) after first_success without streaming | Console + Email | Streaming is a sticky feature; promoting it increases week-1 repeat usage | Activated but no streaming | D7 retention; streaming adoption | 6 | 6 | 7 | 6.3 | first_streaming_success event; docs update | Paula + Marissa | Candidate for W2 iteration | IN (Stretch)

EXP-08 | Error-based JIT prompt: after 2 auth errors show targeted help + direct link to key permissions | Console | Contextual troubleshooting reduces support tickets + unblocks activation | New signups hitting auth errors | Activation @72h; error-to-success conversion | 7 | 6 | 6 | 6.3 | Error classification; copy; support link tracking | Marissa + Dev | Needs error taxonomy mapping | IN (Stretch)

EXP-09 | Landing page variant (quickstart + benchmarks + troubleshooting) tied to email/ads | Web | Dedicated “activation page” reduces dropoff vs. docs sprawl | Email + retargeting traffic | Activation rate from click; CTR→activation | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6.0 | Web resources; benchmark substantiation | Ben + Ethan + Soojin | Outline drafted | IN (Sprint) if web bandwidth

EXP-10 | “Cost/latency dashboard” nudge after first_success (banner + tooltip) | Console | Showing immediate value (observability) increases repeat usage | Activated users | D7 retention; dashboard_viewed | 6 | 5 | 7 | 6.0 | dashboard_viewed event | Marissa + Alicia | Depends on dashboard events | IN (Stretch)

EXP-11 | Email variant A/B: subject line + CTA to “hello inference” snippet (TS + Python) | Email | Better “copy/paste” CTA increases first_success for SDK users | New signups by SDK | Activation @72h; time-to-first-success | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6.0 | Docs/SDK snippets merged; link mapping | Tyler + DevEx | Waiting on SDK PR timing | IN (Sprint) as part of EXP-01 variants

EXP-12 | Sales-assist trigger: if user hits 3+ blockers (errors + no activation) prompt “Talk to Solutions” | Console | Some teams need help; timely handoff increases activation + pipeline | Mid-market signups (heuristic) | Activation; meeting booked | 6 | 4 | 5 | 5.0 | Targeting rules; routing; Sales buy-in | Avery + Marissa | Not scoped | OUT (Sprint)

EXP-13 | Credit incentive: small token credit after first_success to encourage week-1 usage | Incentive | Incentive nudges second session; improves D7 retention | New activated users | D7 retention; usage volume | 6 | 4 | 4 | 4.7 | Incentive policy approval; finance; abuse controls | Ben + Finance TBD | High overhead | OUT (Sprint)

EXP-14 | In-product “Invite teammate” nudge after dashboard_viewed | Console | Team adoption correlates with retention; prompt increases invites | Activated users | teammate_invited; D14 retention | 5 | 4 | 6 | 5.0 | invite event tracking; design time | Marissa | Later | OUT (Sprint)

EXP-15 | Guided “Create a route/deployment” wizard (net-new flow) | Console | A guided deploy flow increases higher-intent milestones (routes) | Power users | route_created | 7 | 3 | 2 | 4.0 | Significant eng; product scope | Product | Not a sprint item | OUT (Sprint)

----------------------------------------------------------------------
IN SCOPE (Sprint commitment target)
----------------------------------------------------------------------
Must ship / measure:
- EXP-01 onboarding email sequence v1 + basic variants
- EXP-02 triggered email for “key created but stalled” (if instrumentation ready)
- EXP-03 checklist v1 in console (behind flag)
- EXP-04 at least 1 console banner (first request)
- EXP-05 retargeting for non-activated signups + measurement/UTMs

Likely W2 iteration (time permitting):
- EXP-06 lapsed retargeting audience
- EXP-07 streaming nudge
- EXP-08 auth error JIT help
- EXP-09 landing page variant (depends on web bandwidth)

----------------------------------------------------------------------
OUT OF SCOPE (explicitly not doing this sprint)
----------------------------------------------------------------------
- Incentives / credits (policy + abuse + finance approval cycle too heavy for 3 weeks)
- Net-new product flows (route/deploy wizard)
- Sales-assist prompts unless we have clear targeting + routing + owner coverage
- Any “benchmarks” claims in ads/emails without a stable link we can stand behind

----------------------------------------------------------------------
NOTES / OPEN QUESTIONS
----------------------------------------------------------------------
1) Activation definition final: first 2xx completion vs. first streaming success vs. dashboard view.
   - Proposed: primary = first_request_success (2xx + completed generation) within 72h.
   - Track secondary = first_streaming_success and dashboard_viewed as leading indicators of retention.
   - Henry/Paula to confirm final on PM-412.

2) Segment definitions (for reporting cuts):
   - Self-serve devs (no sales touch)
   - Regions: NA/EU (APAC separately if sample)
   - SDK: TS vs Python vs curl-only

3) Suppression rules for email:
   - Hard opt-out respected across all lifecycle comms (compliance sensitive)
   - Suppress if already activated (except “next steps” email)
   - Throttle if user has support ticket open? (Need Support input)

4) Measurement plumbing sanity check:
   - UTMs captured client-side + stitched server-side into event props
   - Dashboard shows activation @24h/@72h, time-to-first-success, D7/D14 retention
   - Guardrails: unsubscribe spikes, support-link clicks, error banner clicks

5) Resourcing risk:
   - Console changes require QA automation coverage + perf check before ramp
   - Landing page variant depends on web bandwidth (if no bandwidth, use docs page + UTMs)
